{{Quote|These three are my best assassins&mdash;the Blood Carver is Ku Vrat, and this charming Anzati couple are Sint and Nakia Yoru.|[[Lun Rask]] to [[Nieve Gromia]]|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
'''Nakia Yoru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and the wife of [[Sint Yoru]].

==Biography==
Nakia and her husband, as well as the [[Blood Carver]] [[Ku Vrat]], were employed by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]] to kill both former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] agent [[Gunn Yage]] at the behest of [[Nieve Gromia]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].

Nakia and Sint tracked Skywalker and Yage to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where Nakia killed the drunk [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Bushman Krentz]] by draining his [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]].<ref name="Legacy 38" /> The trio then followed their targets into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], where they were forced to make a stop due to the sandstorm. The Anzati had found their prey at the abandoned [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], where a fight ensued, in which Nakia's husband and Vrat were killed and she herself was taken captive. Skywalker, [[Morrigan Corde]] and [[Jariah Syn]] forced her to lead them to Vigo Rask's base of operation, which they reached in the Yorus' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Anzat One]]''.

On the way Corde had poisoned Nakia and threatened to deny her the antidote in case she refused to cooperate. After Vigo Rask was disposed of, Nakia received her "antidote," which was actually a substance that ended her life.<ref name="Legacy 40">[[Legacy (2006) 40|''Legacy'' (2006) 40]]</ref>
